facts.business: Intec Capital Limited is a non-banking financial company focused on recovery and resolution of legacy loan assets, currently building a war chest for future investments and preparing to launch a recovery services business.

auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on One Time Settlement (OTS) with lender banks completed during the year with net loss of Rs. 124.38 lakhs shown as exceptional item; Material Uncertainty Related to Going Concern due to huge accumulated losses, non-carrying out lending/operational activities, and substantial reduction in recoveries resulting in substantial erosion of net worth.

key_risks: Material uncertainty related to going concern due to huge accumulated losses
Substantial reduction in recoveries from borrowers/customers
Full weight of tariffs yet to be felt
